items.summary: Versions and aliases: jev-latest on TypeSafe's API now gives jev-1.14.0 (first seen 24 Oct 2026, 05:12 UTC; jev-1.13.0 at 23 Oct, 05:45 UTC; no dated announcement); jev-1.13.0 is still listed by its ID with no deprecation date. Opper's typesafe/jev-latest still gave 1.13 that morning. Title without "preview"; six-route table. Pages that name a default model now say what an unpinned request gets.

Benchmarks: new section on the four decision leaderboards that list Jev (Jev Decision Index, Artificial Analysis Decision Index, JevMan, JevBench): who runs each, what you can check, and Jev's listed position. Base Labs' "#1 of 208" claim matches the Jev Decision Index's 20 Oct data, not its 22 Oct data. Leaderboards are not graded.

Benchmarks: four studies graded (B45 and B46 grade A, B47 and B48 grade C); the ledger has 45 graded rows: A 14, B 14, C 10, D 7. Five grade-A comparisons of Jev with OpenAI's Decisions API differ by task, with no overall direction. Same grades on alternatives, the decision-API comparison and reranking and RAG.

Decision-API comparison and alternatives: since general availability OpenAI's Decisions API discounts cached input ($0.01 per 1M tokens) and charges cache writes ($0.125 or $0.25 per 1M); input $0.10 and free output unchanged. The 13 Oct beta wording is kept as dated.
New dated report: jev-latest now gives Jev 1.14; decision leaderboards and four new graded studies (24 Oct 2026).

Home adds a notice for the move (three notices); none retired.

Limitations: new section "Jev with images". Of 8 SDKs and integrations read in package files, 5 send images to Jev and 2 of those add TypeSafe's opt-in header for you; pydantic-ai refuses images and both LangChain packages pass them as text. TypeSafe's image docs quoted with times; no image was sent.

n8n: TypeSafe's node 0.10.0 keeps the same failure behaviour and adds an Images field that sends PNG or JPEG with the opt-in header. Image lines also on TypeScript, Python, frameworks (pydantic-ai-slim 2.60.0 still refuses images) and errors and limits.

Versions and aliases: sentences that described the jev-latest move as upcoming now give its state on 23 Oct (still jev-1.13.0, no date published). All six routes list a Jev 1.14 ID; a versioned ID can be written on 6 of 6 routes for 1.14 and 5 of 6 for 1.13. Route image fields re-read.

Decision-API comparison and alternatives: OpenAI's Decisions API became generally available on 22 Oct 2026; same model and input price; up to 400 questions per request (200 in the beta). Not re-graded.
When Jev fails and coding agents: the pinned jev-gateway links now point to the repository named in its npm record, at the same commit; cells unchanged.
New dated report: Jev with images, what 8 SDKs and integrations do with an image, and the route counts for Jev 1.14 (23 Oct 2026).
